notes.title: Dev Diary #5
notes.content:
Hello Everyone! 

We hope you had some nice holidays! We are back full of energy and ready to share what we’ve been making these past few weeks.


 Cheshire has been with us from the beginning, but now he has got a beautiful new sprite, shader, and animations!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43861627/19f90b8a51774c3038c1ae5a536032a355e9d469.gif

 A while back we asked you all on X which dialogue bubbles you liked the most, so we’ve taken the result and this is how it turned out!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43861627/50e906f15680b08e3c12de00093fb3cf162dbbc8.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43861627/106a29ba70bc5824f5b0e325da365dd325fb9a49.gif

 Here is a sneak peek of Alice’s third eye ability, which will reveal secrets across the map. Use it if something looks suspicious!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43861627/65db64942d9c4dc16782cd2b85720e8c05e84d9e.gif



Be sure to follow us on X and wishlist the game on Steam if you haven’t! It helps us a lot!
See you in the next Dev Diary!
